title: Psyduck Surreal Portrait
description: A giant cracked humanoid head with dark red skin and glowing yellow eyes floats in the sky above a Mediterranean coastal village. A large yellow Psyduck head with a vacant expression emerges from the top, surrounded by flowering pink branches against a sunset sea and mountain backdrop.
prompt: Surreal painting of a giant cracked dark red humanoid head with glowing eyes floating above a coastal Mediterranean village at sunset. A large yellow Psyduck head with blank white eyes emerges from the cracked skull. Flowering pink branches wrap around the heads. Italian-style houses with terracotta roofs, purple bougainvillea, distant mountains and a sailboat on the sea visible below, dramatic cinematic lighting.
